body:
My friend and colleague Gareth Higgins will be offering a beautiful seven-week experience you can be part of from wherever you are. It’s called Dreaming the World . You’ll find information here:

 https://www.theporchmagazine.com/dreaming-the-world

 I have a feeling this could be a highlight of your year.
